title: Admin Training, Website Launch & Domain Recovery
format: In-person working session — hands-on admin training
tldr: Hands-on training session at the shop, walking Kate (and new hire Lola) through the admin. The big mental model landed: a "class" is the reusable course definition; a "cohort" is a dated session/group of that class — so you build a class once and just add (or duplicate) cohorts for each new set of dates instead of recreating everything. Kate gathered a punch-list of course-creation UX fixes (make image upload easier, mark required vs. optional fields, add placeholders, alt-text should be optional). The website is the next milestone: review the copy, send photos, and pull existing content from the current HostGator site — plus Lola caught a mobile bug (the landing-page hero/backdrop is blocked out on phones). On Pacific: the team mapped the exact Google account recovery path (log in → "Try another way" → verification code to Jeff's recovery email → then change recovery to the shop's own), pending getting Jeff to a computer for the 10-minute code. The Pacific check-in form just needs the redundant "authorize repair" box removed. Plan for go-live: flip real Stripe payments for a few in-person guinea-pig customers (RentItBiz stays up in parallel), verify it lands correctly in Lightspeed, then transfer the domain.

actionItems.action: Add all classes + cohorts (mainly cohorts) — the scuba certification classes & Scuba Discoveries through Sept–Dec; edit/verify course info as they go.
Send the HostGator login (plus any business copy/docs) so the team can pull existing website content.
Get Jeff on a call / by his computer to read the Google verification code (10-min window); provide his details.
Review website copy + layout; send photos (team, instructors, facility). Be brutally honest.
Play with Trips in the admin; confirm it displays the way she wants.
Save the admin PIN once Austin sends it.
Run more people through the booking flow (Lola included); do a real/fake end-to-end test and report anything confusing.
Make image upload easier (file upload) in course creation.
Make alt text + non-essential fields optional; add ★ required markers, "optional" labels, and placeholders.
Fix the mobile landing-page hero (backdrop/"Dive Deep" blocked out on phones).
Confirm/renew the Lightspeed token so the tuition-item SKU search works.
Remove the authorization box from the Pacific check-in form.
Set up auto/confirmation emails on course signup.
Confirm remaining Stripe logistics (tax ID, etc.) and finish wiring.
Walk Kate through the full e-learning-code + Lightspeed flow over Zoom with a test; audit the first real sales.
Pull/copy existing content from HostGator once Kate provides the login.
Set a go-live goal date; enable real Stripe payments for a few guinea pigs; plan to swing by a Saturday Scuba Discovery (9–11am).
Build a laminated one-pager of the admin/tech process — after the admin UX is finalized.
